Data Mobilisation Priorities

Actionable Targets for Closing Biodiversity Data Gaps

GBIF Gap Finder

June 22, 2026

Overview

This report synthesises the gap analysis into actionable priorities for data mobilisation. It identifies specific spatial cells, taxonomic groups, and institutional gaps that should be targeted to improve GBIF data completeness.

Recommended Actions

Priority Detail
Spatial: Fill zero-coverage cells 28 grid cells have never been surveyed.
Temporal: Resurvey stale cells 331 cells have not been surveyed in over 5 years.
Taxonomic: Close species coverage gaps 54,361 backbone species have no GBIF records.
Threatened: Monitor CR and EN species 71 CR/EN species lack any GBIF occurrence data.
Sensitive: Assess data availability 185 species have restricted coordinates (5–50 km generalisation).
Infrastructure: Diversify data sources 344 of 4,988 grid cells depend on a single publisher.
